Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 24: the slip of [[Dark Reconnaissance (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on opponent's location. Wherever you have two Mistryl, your Force drains are +1. "Stolen" on Swilla Corey is treated as "placed in owner's Used Pile" and it may target a weapon instead of a device. Your Force drains here cannot be modified or canceled by opponent.”), word for word the text of [[Dark Reconnaissance]]. The label under the slip reads “•Quietly Observing (V)”, as printed in the Master List.<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
